milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining a spruce trapdoor drops it as an item that ends up in the player's inventory. The trapdoor is at spawn-relative (0, 0, 3) and must be broken to access the ladder shaft below. inventory_has is preferred over mine_block event since the item reliably enters inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find lava' is an observation/locate task — the player must navigate near the lava pool and be facing it. The lava pool center is at spawn-relative (0, -5, 9). max_distance=16 allows detection from the ladder shaft area or while on the walkways. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the lava.

Uses inventory_has because mining a blue bed drops it as an item that enters the player's inventory. The bed is at spawn-relative (-2, -5, 13/14) in the room beyond the lava. Mining either the head or foot part drops one blue_bed item. inventory_has is the preferred rule for mine tasks.
